title: Space planet
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run build'

checks.name: Initial state and lazy media
checks.detail: Earth featured, Venus left, Mars right; only Earth has src at DOMContentLoaded.

checks.name: Entrance cleanup
checks.detail: Both animation classes removed after one entrance.

checks.name: Google fonts
checks.detail: Prata, Hanken Grotesk and Poppins loaded.

checks.name: Planet rotation and media
checks.detail: Real button clicks Earth → Venus → Mars → Earth restore exact initial state; all three videos play; image sources unchanged.

checks.name: Mobile navigation
checks.detail: Open, Escape with focus return, link click and outside click all work. Same five navigation links.

checks.name: Keyboard planet switching
checks.detail: Enter on focused planet button switches the featured planet.

checks.name: Reduced motion
checks.detail: No entrance classes; videos hidden; still switches correctly to Venus.

checks.name: Horizontal overflow
checks.detail: No body/document horizontal overflow at every integer width 320–2560, plus phone/tablet/landscape cases.

checks.name: Runtime and network
checks.detail: No JavaScript/console errors or unexpected request failures.

notes: Single authored HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript; no framework or external JavaScript. The head initializer is the additional inline script explicitly required by the prompt.
Build validates and copies index.html to dist/index.html. No compilation is required to run the source.
Verified at /motionsites-results/space-planet/ in Chromium. Required screenshots are screenshots/desktop.png (1440x1000) and screenshots/mobile.png (390x844).
All nine exact CloudFront assets and Google font files responded successfully. All three videos played. No recovery or approximation was needed.
Cutout timing measures the synchronous six image-class toggles; complete click-handler timings, including media operations, are separately recorded in screenshots/browser-report.json.
The prompt uses placeholder links and supplies no second section; no extra flows were added. Original external assets remain network dependencies.
No agents, other sessions, pushes, deployment, or messages were used. Only this project was written. Ready means available for acceptance, not deployed.
